# E008 -- Bistro.sk Design Manual

## Metadata
- **Company:** Bistro.sk
- **Industry:** Food & Beverage
- **Year:** 2018
- **Source file:** Bistro_Dizajn manual.pdf
- **Pages:** 55
- **Language:** SK
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- "Dizajn manual" (Design Manual) dated September 2018
- 7 chapters: Uvod (Intro), Logo, Farebnost (Color), Typografia, Tone of Voice, Komunikacia (Communication), Branding
- "Zakladne hodnoty znacky" (Basic brand values) on p.5
- Very comprehensive 55-page manual for a food delivery/restaurant platform
- Covers full spectrum: strategy, visual identity, TOV, communication channels, branded collateral

## Logo
- Multiple logo variants: zakladny tvar (standard), inverzny (inverse), cerveno-biely (red-white), cierno-biely (black-white), cierno-biely inverzny (black-white inverse)
- Logo animation and sound (p.14) -- sonic branding included
- Contrast chart (p.15) -- tests logo against various backgrounds
- Clear space (ochranna zona) defined (p.16)
- Minimum size rules (p.17)
- "Nepovolene tvary" (prohibited logo usage) on p.18
- Black-white version for special cases: single-color print, engraving, stamps

## Typography
- "Zakladny font" (primary font) on p.23
- "Doplnkovy font" (secondary/complementary font) on p.24
- Two-font system

## Color
- "Zakladna farebnost" (primary colors) on p.20
- "Doplnkova farebnost" (secondary/complementary colors) on p.21
- Two-tier color system (primary + secondary)

## Graphics
- No dedicated illustration/pattern section observed in TOC
- Logo animation suggests motion graphics capability

## Photography
- No dedicated photography section; food imagery likely covered within communication examples

## Applications
- Extensive branded collateral section (pp.42-54): vehicle wraps, paper bags, promotional textiles, notebooks, pens, napkins, stickers, keychains, leaflets, business cards, parasols
- Restaurant-specific vehicle wraps (separate from general wraps)
- Communication channels: offline (ATL/BTL), online, social media (FB posts, carousels), direct e-mailing, mobile app icon
- Mobile app icon guidelines (p.40)

## Tone of Voice
- Brand personality defined as: uvolnenost (relaxedness), priamociarost (directness), prekvapivost (surprisingness)
- Brand belief: removing food choice limitations -- "what if nothing limited your food choices"
- Brand vision: people care more about what they eat but cook less at home; delivery is not just pizza
- Brand promise: everyone should be able to order whatever they crave in a few clicks
- TOV examples provided: FB posts (p.27), reactions to feedback (p.28), newsletter (p.29)
- Written in conversational, informal Slovak

## Outliers
- Sonic branding (logo animation + sound) is unusual for this company size/industry
- Very thorough for a food delivery platform -- 55 pages covering everything from strategy to parasol designs
- Brand framework uses English terms (Brand belief, Brand vision, Brand promise, Brand personality) within Slovak text
- Manual stated as internal-use only, to be continually updated with printed pages delivered

## Quality Score
- **Score: 4/5** -- Remarkably comprehensive design manual for a food delivery brand. Covers brand strategy, full visual identity, tone of voice with examples, communication channels, and extensive branded collateral. Sonic branding is a standout. Only lacks dedicated photography/illustration sections.
